event: Arena Season 1 is live. Official notice: the defense team's DMG reduction isn't applied this season; fixed from Season 2.
Patch notes: Arena battles resume after a force-quit; a warning appears when refreshing opponents costs crystals.
crumblehub's curated Arena meta decks: a 5★ Rye carry and a 5★ Espresso carry on a Wind Archer / Milky Way / Doughnut King core.
Patch: Champion 1–3 tiers from Arena Season 3, promotion by absolute rank, defense start positions no longer random. Pinot Noir's healing reduction ends the heal meta.
Patch notes: continuous challenge (auto-repeat attacks) added to Arena.
The Rye one-carry idea appears: Rye deals 2.47M and wins across a 3–4M power gap against multi-ranged decks.
Pre-Bari peak: a server #1 runs the five-ranged deck at 14.58M and 3,911 trophies.
Rumble Arena (와글와글 아레나) announced as a cross-server arena; official EN and TW teasers.
Patch 1.4.002: Princess Bari, Moon Rabbit (Persimmon) and the Skill Ready stat. An evasion deck finishes Arena Season 4 at Grand Master 2, 9th overall.
Rumble Arena Season 1 opens with the Charge +30% max HP and all +30% DR buff. On day 1 the top 3 all run Oven Wanderer.
Official warning against pre-arranged win trading in Arena.
The 'info-tab' Rye one-carry deck is posted (13.87M); a 1★-Bari Oven deck beats older decks at twice its power.
러너's F2P Rye deck (18.77M) beats a 27M Oven/Bari/Brightseeker team; a 2★-Bari charge deck wins with Bari doing 2.03M.
Rockstar replaces Grapevine in the Rye deck; a 13.27M Rye deck beats a 20.4M server #2 running Bari–Oven.
ㄹㄹ노아 is #1 at 3,406 points (Champion 1) and gives his Bari and Ion runes: 피감 체력 스증 스가.
A Chain deck (17.59M) beats a 17–18M Rye deck 3 times out of 3.
The top of at least one server drifts back to the Rye deck; Bari–Oven is described as the #1's tool.
crumb.gg board: #1 凱凱の餅乾軍團 at 4095 runs the standard 12; ratings rose from 3311 (#1) and 2367 (#100) on 09-24 to 4089 and 2835.
Rumble Arena Season 1 ends at 12:00 KST (battles close 03:00 UTC); rewards pay out automatically.
